local_review.finding_body: The copied OpenTelemetrySdkTraceTest directly used Class.forName/getDeclaredField to manufacture reflection evidence, violating FS-test-contract.2.1 and FS-contribution-contract.4.3. The copied build.gradle also retained --allow-incomplete-classpath without evidence that every compliant test shape requires it, violating FS-test-contract.2.7. The complete current-defaults, future-defaults, and GraalVM 25 native lanes passed after both were removed.
local_review.finding_title: Generated repair retained test-side reflection and an unnecessary Native Image flag
local_review.fix_note: Removed the direct reflection assertions/helper while retaining the queue's functional API assertions, and removed --allow-incomplete-classpath because all required native lanes build and run without it.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete coordinate-scoped diff and local evidence. The 1.59.0 compile adaptation preserves the existing tracer configurator and exception-attribute behavior. Overall and reflection dynamic-access coverage both remain 4/4 (100%) versus 1.55.0. After the repair, the exact Forge finalizer passed all three native-test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
